response.justification: The candidate has deep technical breadth, strong open-source contributions, and leadership in project development, but lacks demonstrated experience in IT architecture design, UML modeling, and formal team leadership — and critically, only has basic German proficiency, which violates a core requirement.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong open-source contributions with real-world impact (GISCollective)
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor through workshops
concerns: German proficiency is only basic, not C1 as required
No evidence of UML, enterprise architecture, or requirements management experience
Lacks documented team leadership or project management responsibilities
